description.p: Image Tracer turns bitmaps (PNG, JPEG, …) into scalable SVG vectors. Pick a preset for logos, screenshots or line art, or fine-tune every setting in Advanced mode, and compare the result side by side with the original.

ul.li: Full color, black & white, grayscale, outlines, posterize and line drawing modes
Screenshot mode with crisp small text, optionally recognized as real, editable SVG text (OCR)
Perceptual color palettes, JPEG noise removal and fixed palettes
Compact SVG output with gap-free shapes

description.p: Native packages for Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora and Arch, an AppImage, and Windows and macOS installers.
